summary.text: Simone Coleman, a Working Class Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 13th District to Donavan McKinney.
She had run for office in Detroit-area races before, and little other biographical information is available in public sources.

paragraphs.text: Coleman ran as the Working Class Party candidate for Michigan House District 14 in 2020.
She appeared on the general-election ballot for Michigan's 13th District in 2022 and 2024, and advanced from the Working Class Party convention for the 2026 race on June 6, 2026.
She received 2.1% of the vote to Donavan McKinney's 76.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
